in_sanskrit.name: Himani
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Himani is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Hima' which means 'snow' or 'frost'. In Hindu mythology, Himani can be associated with the goddess Hima, who is also known as Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom.

in_hindi.name: हिमानि
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the name Himani can be translated to 'सन्धूपनाला' which means 'one who serves sandalwood'. However, the original meaning of the name is 'snow' or 'frost', as it is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Hima'.
